Side forecast, pre-score: exp89r's display predicts exp89t (0.958 -> P(exp89t >= 0.960) ~0.75; 0.957 -> ~0.11).

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION. EXP75 PARTNER RULE v2 (b) (CONTEXT 28 Sep 14:12Z), from R25-A4, and card v5 l.38/l.55/l.89 say: with a CI V_pub, P2 {V_pub, exp75} enters 'only as a trade at >= 0.955', 'CI in both files, CI not insured', and 'P3 {V_pub, #37} goes first'. The stated reason (R25-A4) was that exp75 hedges only cap while CI is hedged only by #37. R34-RC-B already found that reason half wrong: exp75 hedges both cap 6 and K. Its skeptic noted that under the STANDING prior the model favours P2, which 'argues against rule (b)', but kept the rule because exp75 had no read yet. WHAT CHANGED: (1) Probe 53 exp75 = 0.955 clean (09:09Z; L (8.88, 9.05] h, CI-RAN). That is rule (b)'s pre-registered trigger for 'show as a trade', and it is the third out-of-sample public CI read of +0.001, on a third base (exp70g, exp85a and now #37 at cap 4). (2) The finals are ~10 h away. RE-RUN: scratchpad r26/mc26.py unchanged, VPUB=exp87a, partners #37/exp75/exp85a, seed 37, 12 runs. Bronze / silver, P2 vs P3: standing prior CI N(+0.0005, 0.0008) .815/.612 vs .784/.571. CI sd 0.0012: .790/.614 vs .782/.574. CI sd 0.0015: .773/.615 vs .779/.578. CI +0.0007 (a modest update for reads 2 and 3) with sd 0.0008/0.0012/0.0015: .846/.649 vs .802/.597, .819/.648 vs .798/.600, .800/.645 vs .795/.601. K_MU +0.0003: .787/.596 vs .749/.525. RHO 0.5: .809/.639 vs .778/.579. Overfit field: .866/.727 vs .863/.676. qpub0: .778/.571 vs .746/.500. CI mean 0: .713/.532 vs .741/.513. CI mean -0.0003: .663/.480 vs .718/.473. So P2 leads silver in 12 of 12 and bronze in 9 of 12. The bronze break-even is a private CI mean of ~+0.0003 at sd 0.0012 (~+0.0005 at sd 0.0015), i.e. about 1/3 to 1/2 of CI's public step. CI's downside tail is also bounded by construction (ALPHA 0.5, MAX_UM 3.0), which argues for the lower sd rows. NEW VERDICT: the ORDER 'P3 first' is NOT SUPPORTED by the pre-read model. It holds only if the user believes CI transfers to the private embryos at under ~1/3 of its public effect, or may reverse sign. The model is judgmental and only ranks (I-092), and 'which pair' is a genuine private-risk preference. So the procedure stays: no post-hoc reorder of the registered card, no word 'recommend' (card step 11), and the user gets the trade with its break-even in one sentence.

On that basis rule (a) sends exp89s (K + DIS 2.25, non-CI) at exp89r >= 0.958, and the 08:28Z hold makes it the slot-2 default at ~12:00Z. R36 rejected blind exp89s variants (R36H-2, PC36-03) as 'no slot'. WHAT CHANGED: exp89t (= exp89s + CI) was approved at 08:27Z and submitted at 09:00:17Z (probe 55). It reads at ~18:17-18:29Z, which is ~40-60 min before exp89s would (a 12:00Z non-CI submit reads at ~18:52-19:49Z). CI has read exactly +0.001 on all 3 bases (probes 48, 51, 53), so on the public embryo exp89t >= exp89s almost surely, and the running champion rule (02:02Z (2)) lets a later equal display replace the champion only with an attributable UP. RE-RUN (scratchpad r37/mc37_s_vs_t.py; additive model; CI N(+0.001, 0.0005), SEC N(-0.0015, 0.001), DIS N(0, 0.0012), constrained to the displays exp85a 0.958, exp87a 0.959, exp89p 0.956). If exp89t reads on time, P(exp89s becomes V_pub) = 0.000 at every d_R, because exp89s never displays above exp89t. With P(exp89t late past 10.75 h or ERROR) = 0.03, it is 0.0001 / 0.003 / 0.016 / 0.029 at d_R 0.957 / 0.958 / 0.959 / 0.960; with 0.10 it is 0.0004 / 0.011 / 0.052 / 0.095. The CI family's observed L is 8.88-9.48 h over 3 reads (exp79a, exp87a, exp75), so 0.03 is the realistic figure. Side result: exp89r's display is a strong pre-read of exp89t, because exp89t = exp89r - SEC. P(exp89t >= 0.960 | d_R) = 0.11 / 0.75 / 1.00 / 1.00 at 0.957 / 0.958 / 0.959 / 0.960. That is an upper bound, since the lab's SEC x CI interaction (~+0.0004, R36-RC-B) would lower it. NEW VERDICT: REVISED DOWN. R36H-1's switch probabilities were computed before exp89t existed and no longer apply. exp89s in slot 2 is now insurance against exp89t missing the tick or failing, worth <= 0.3% (d_R 0.958) to ~2-3% (d_R 0.959-0.960) of a V_pub switch. Sending it (rule (a) default, 0 GPU, v1 = gated dummy) and leaving the slot UNUSED are practically equal. The late-0.958 clause of rule (a) (0.958 with L_hi > 10.2 h -> UNUSED) is conservative. A late read can only understate the file, because the in-kernel insertion gate may have skipped DaughterNet forks. The clause is moot at this value, so no amendment is proposed.
